artifacts.title: Six-month PCA membership requirement for ministerial candidacy from non-PCA church
artifacts.disposition: advice given — BCO 18-2 probably requires PCA membership; overture recommended

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that BCO 18-2 probably requires PCA congregation membership for candidacy, but acknowledged varying presbytery practice and recommended an overture to clarify whether endorsement from a non-PCA ruling body is permissible.

artifacts.title: Presbytery authority to judge theonomy as heresy under WCF 19-4

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that a presbytery retains the right to examine and judge a man heretical on WCF 19-4 grounds, provided the error is demonstrated by specific evidence.
